mapper.select: SELECT st.id AS service_type_id, st.name AS service_type_name, COUNT(q.id) FILTER (WHERE q.status = 'WAITING')::integer AS waiting_count, COALESCE( ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (q.completed_at - q.started_at)) / 60) FILTER (WHERE q.started_at IS NOT NULL AND q.completed_at IS NOT NULL)), 5 )::integer AS average_processing_minutes FROM service_types st LEFT JOIN queue_tickets q ON q.service_type_id = st.id AND q.health_center_id = st.health_center_id AND q.issued_at::date = CURRENT_DATE WHERE st.health_center_id = #{healthCenterId} AND st.active = true GROUP BY st.id, st.name ORDER BY st.id

SELECT h.hour::integer AS hour, COUNT(v.id)::integer AS visit_count FROM generate_series(0, 23) h(hour) LEFT JOIN visits v ON EXTRACT(HOUR FROM v.checked_in_at)::integer = h.hour AND v.health_center_id = #{healthCenterId} AND v.checked_in_at::date = #{targetDate} GROUP BY h.hour ORDER BY h.hour

SELECT st.id AS service_type_id, st.name AS service_type_name, COALESCE( ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (q.called_at - q.issued_at)) / 60) FILTER (WHERE q.called_at IS NOT NULL)), 0 )::integer AS average_wait_minutes, COUNT(q.id) FILTER (WHERE q.called_at IS NOT NULL)::integer AS called_count FROM service_types st LEFT JOIN queue_tickets q ON q.service_type_id = st.id AND q.health_center_id = st.health_center_id AND q.issued_at::date = #{targetDate} WHERE st.health_center_id = #{healthCenterId} AND st.active = true GROUP BY st.id, st.name ORDER BY st.id

WITH visit_stats AS ( SELECT COUNT(*)::integer AS total_visit_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE visit_type = 'RESERVED')::integer AS reserved_visit_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE visit_type = 'WALK_IN')::integer AS walk_in_visit_count FROM visits WHERE health_center_id = #{healthCenterId} AND checked_in_at::date = #{targetDate} ) SELECT total_visit_count, reserved_visit_count, walk_in_visit_count, CASE WHEN total_visit_count = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE ROUND((reserved_visit_count::numeric / total_visit_count::numeric) * 100, 1) END AS reserved_visit_ratio, CASE WHEN total_visit_count = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE ROUND((walk_in_visit_count::numeric / total_visit_count::numeric) * 100, 1) END AS walk_in_visit_ratio FROM visit_stats

WITH reservation_stats AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status != 'CANCELED')::integer AS target_reservation_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'NO_SHOW')::integer AS no_show_reservation_count FROM reservations WHERE health_center_id = #{healthCenterId} AND reserved_at::date = #{targetDate} ) SELECT target_reservation_count, no_show_reservation_count, CASE WHEN target_reservation_count = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE ROUND((no_show_reservation_count::numeric / target_reservation_count::numeric) * 100, 1) END AS no_show_rate FROM reservation_stats
